description: Push a segment to a Meta custom audience and keep it synced on a schedule. Provide `segmentId` for an existing segment OR `predefinedSegmentId` for a ready-made template (for example "zero-ltv", "no-purchase-1y", "recent-buyers", "high-spenders-ecom", "non-buyers", "engaged") - the template segment is created automatically on first use. The first upload runs immediately. Note: audiences are add-only; subscribers who later leave the segment stay in the Meta audience.

audienceName.description: Name for the custom audience in Meta Ads Manager.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

frequency.description: How often to re-upload the segment. Default: daily.

predefinedSegmentId.description: Predefined segment template ID (for example "zero-ltv", "no-purchase-1y", "recent-buyers"). The segment is created automatically if it does not exist. Mutually exclusive with `segmentId`.

segmentId.description: Existing segment ID to sync. Mutually exclusive with `predefinedSegmentId`.

name: create_audience_sync

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_audience_sync` MCP tool.

audienceSync.description: The audience sync record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.
